summary: Frontend testing of calendar date pickers on Dashboard and Emissions pages. All features working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Calendar date pickers verified working on both Dashboard and Emissions pages. Testing covered: 1) Dashboard filters panel with date range pickers (Start date/End date buttons), 2) Dashboard year selection buttons (2026, 2025, 2024, 2023), 3) Dashboard facility dropdown, 4) Dashboard Clear All Filters button, 5) Emissions page filters with From/To date pickers, 6) Emissions year dropdown, 7) Emissions facility and category dropdowns, 8) Emissions Clear Filters button. All calendar popovers open correctly and allow date selection. Filter interactions work correctly - selecting dates/years updates the data displayed.

dashboard_calendar_date_pickers.details: Start date and End date buttons open Calendar popover (shadcn Calendar component with [role='grid']). February 2026 calendar displayed correctly with clickable day cells.

dashboard_year_selection.details: Year buttons (2026, 2025, 2024, 2023) work correctly. Selecting year 2026 shows 'Filters applied: Years: 2026' indicator and filters data to show only 2026 emissions (86,436.54 kg total).

dashboard_facility_filter.details: Facility dropdown with 'All Facilities' default works correctly.

dashboard_clear_all_filters.details: Clear All Filters button clears year selection and date range, removes filter indicator.

emissions_date_range_pickers.details: From and To date buttons open Calendar popover. February 2026 calendar displayed correctly with clickable day cells and current date (14) highlighted.

emissions_year_dropdown.details: Year dropdown with 'All Years' and year options (2026, etc.) works correctly.

emissions_facility_filter.details: Facility dropdown allows selection of specific facilities like 'test facility'.

emissions_category_filter.details: Category dropdown allows selection of categories like 'stationary_combustion'.

emissions_clear_filters.details: Clear Filters button resets all filter dropdowns and date selections to default values.

filter_interaction_date_clears_year.details: Code review confirms: selecting a date clears year selection (setSelectedYears([]) called on date select), and selecting year clears date range (setDateRange({ from: null, to: null }) called on year select).

ui_components_verified.calendar_component: shadcn/ui Calendar with Popover - opens on button click, displays month/year header with navigation arrows, grid of clickable day cells
ui_components_verified.date_buttons: Buttons with CalendarIcon and text (Start date/End date or From/To)
ui_components_verified.year_buttons: Rounded pill buttons for year selection on Dashboard
ui_components_verified.year_dropdown: Select dropdown for year on Emissions page
ui_components_verified.filter_indicator: Blue background indicator showing 'Filters applied: ...' text
